semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly requires a combinational circuit with 100 inputs and AND, OR, XOR outputs.
semantics.out_and: 1 exactly when all 100 binary inputs are 1
semantics.out_or: 1 exactly when at least one binary input is 1
semantics.out_xor: 1 exactly when an odd number of binary inputs are 1
semantics.timing: Combinational, no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No stored state; outputs depend on current inputs

numeric.arithmetic: Boolean gates; XOR is parity, without signed arithmetic

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit counting for binary vectors derived from the original gate definitions
verification.sampling: Sample after a 1 ns combinational settling delay
verification.directed: All zeros, all ones, each single one, each single zero, low-bit masks with every population count from 0 through 100
verification.additional: Deterministic randomized vectors and conventional four-state gate propagation checks
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: The original problem does not explicitly define X/Z behavior. Use standard Verilog four-state gate semantics; supplementary X/Z checks are a language-semantics assumption, not a new binary-function requirement.
